meta.title: Agent Plugins
meta.description: Manage skills, shortcuts, experts, connectors, and language engines to extend your agent.

en.agentPresetsToggleDesc: Shows the Agent preset manager entry beside Permissions in the composer: enable a preset per session. On by default.
en.autoUpdateDesc: Refreshes every configured source every 6 hours.
en.busyHintProcessing: Your request is being processed. Please wait.
en.busyHintRefresh: The current view will update when the operation finishes.
en.busyHintWaiting: Waiting time depends on local services and network responses.
en.busyLongRunning: This has been waiting a while; a local service or the network may not be responding. Keep waiting, or refresh shortly to see the result.
en.commandsPanelDescription: View shortcuts from plugins and those you create, and edit your own.
en.detailEmptyRowsList: Nothing yet: click to add a line
en.detailEmptyRowsMap: Nothing yet: click to add a line, or paste several KEY=VALUE lines
en.detailUniqueKeys: Keys must be non-empty and unique
en.detailUseJson: These field types cannot be edited as a form. Correct them in JSON.
en.diagnosticsPassed: The manifest, mcp.json, and lspServers all pass validation.
en.editorFooterCreate: Takes effect as soon as it is created; switch it off from the list.
en.editorFooterEdit: Unsaved changes are lost when this closes
en.editorFooterRouting: Only model settings can be changed; the plugin manages expert instructions
en.failureGuideAuth: The service asks for authorization: check that the token is still valid, or authorize again.
en.failureGuideBackend: This backend cannot enforce that setting: switch the MCP backend back to the built-in client.
en.failureGuideBackendMissing: Host compatibility mode needs dsh-mcp-client, which is not installed: switch the MCP backend back to the built-in client.
en.failureGuideCommandMissing: Command not found: check that it is on PATH, or use an absolute path.
en.failureGuideCredentials: Missing credential: fill it in the credentials area, then retry; retrying cannot supply it.
en.failureGuideDisabledOverride: This service is switched off in the configuration override.
en.failureGuideDns: Name resolution failed: check the address, the proxy and the network.
en.failureGuideHostUnsupported: This host does not support mounting plugins at runtime: check the host version and how it was started, then retry.
en.failureGuideMissingPackage: This profile is missing a component the plugin needs: reinstall the plugin to provision its dependencies.
en.failureGuideModifiedOverride: A configuration override changed this service; what runs is not the suite’s own declaration.
en.failureGuideOrphanedTools: The suite that declared it is off or uninstalled, but its tools are still registered: restart the host to clear them.
en.failureGuidePresetDemand: The active session preset selects this service, so it stays mounted; the panel switch cannot unmount it while that preset is active.
en.failureGuideProcessExit: The process exited early: check the command, its arguments and its environment.
en.failureGuideProtocol: The protocol handshake failed: check that a remote address points at the right endpoint, and that a local command runs on its own.
en.failureGuideRefused: Connection refused: check that the service is running, and that the port and path are right.
en.failureGuideSeamConflict: Another layer already registers this seam: remove the hand-added layer, then retry.
en.failureGuideStartup: The service did not finish starting: run its command by hand first to check that its dependencies are installed and its arguments are right, and raise the startup timeout if it needs longer.
en.failureGuideTimeout: Connection timed out: check that the service is reachable; a local server can raise its startup timeout.
en.failureGuideTls: TLS handshake failed: check the certificate; the service may require a VPN or an IP allow-list.
en.failureGuideTransport: That transport is not supported: use stdio or Streamable HTTP.
en.failureGuideUnmount: Unmounting did not finish: the host may still hold the old process; restart the host and try again.
en.feedbackToggleDesc: The agent may auto-file an issue when it hits a problem in this plugin.
en.hookRunIdle: Not run yet. A test run executes this command once in the home directory.
en.hookRunNoCommand: This rejected declaration has no runnable command.
en.hookRunShellUnavailable: No shell is mounted in this configuration.
en.hookRunUnknownDeclaration: Declaration not found. It may belong to another session or have been removed.
en.hooksEventPartial: Partially supported by the host; only permission and idle notifications can run.
en.hooksEventUnsupported: Host does not run this event yet; registered only.
en.hooksPanelSubtitle: Command hooks from your local Agent configuration. Read-only.
en.idFixed: id is fixed (the source identifier is globally unique)
en.installConfirmDesc: After install, the surfaces below inject into your sessions. Confirm you trust the source; see the suite card for details.
en.installConfirmExecutable: Risk notice: installing starts this suite's MCP child processes and mounts hooks (third-party code). Install only if you trust the source.
en.installConfirmLocalTree: Local directory (working tree, no locked commit)
en.installConfirmNoSurfaces: This suite declares no runtime surfaces.
en.loadFail: Failed to load the plugin catalog. Try again later
en.lspFilterAllHint: All: suite-declared and user-configured language servers
en.lspFilterDirectHint: User: language servers configured in this panel
en.lspFilterDisabledHint: Disabled: servers switched off, so they are not mounted
en.lspFilterPluginHint: Plugin: inline lspServers declarations from market suites
en.lspSeamBody: This profile still carries a hand-added LSP layer — the setup instructions shipped before the plugin provided LSP itself asked you to add it. It claims the same seam as the plugin copy, so language servers cannot mount. Removing it is enough; the plugin copy takes over and keeps a backup of the file.
en.lspSeamOther: Other profiles carry the same layer; this action only handles the one above:
en.lspSeamRestart: Removed. Restart DSH for the layer to unload.
en.lspStatusSubtitle: Code navigation, diagnostics, and language-service management over LSP.
en.marketCardDesc: Manage skills, shortcuts, experts, connectors, and language engines to extend your agent.
en.mcpBackendHostMissing: The host dsh-mcp-client is not available here; compat mode cannot be enabled.
en.mcpCardDesc: Built-in bridge with OAuth and SSE; off falls back to the host dsh-mcp-client.
en.mcpCardReadonly: The settings document is read-only in this environment; the switch is unavailable.
en.mcpCredentialEditInEditor: Replace this value in the service editor
en.mcpCredentialHiddenHint: Type a new value to replace it; leaving it empty keeps the stored one
en.mcpCredentialReadOnly: provided by the launch environment (read-only; restart DSH after changes)
en.mcpCredentialRef: credential reference, activate to edit the text
en.mcpCredentialUnavailable: This profile has no credentials service. Set the environment variable before launching DSH.
en.mcpDeleteDesc: This removes the connector from the user MCP declaration. This cannot be undone.
en.mcpDirectBoundary: User MCP entries only show services observed in the current tool registry; the host exposes no config or connection-status API.
en.mcpDuplicateHint: Another source already mounted this server, so this copy was not registered — mounting the same server twice adds nothing for the model. Uninstall the other source's suite and this copy takes over on the next refresh.
en.mcpEntryGone: This service is no longer listed. Close the details and refresh.
en.mcpFilterAllHint: All: MCP services declared by plugin suites plus MCP you added
en.mcpFilterDirectHint: User: MCP observed in the host tool registry outside any suite
en.mcpFilterDisabledHint: Disabled: switched off, so the server is not mounted
en.mcpFilterPluginHint: Plugin: mcp.json declarations from market suites
en.mcpForeignHint: This server is already mounted through another path (native config or another plugin); the market skipped it to avoid a duplicate. To let the market take over, disable the other source first. If it is a leftover mount, a Host restart clears it.
en.mcpHostStartupUnsupported: The host compatibility backend cannot enforce a startup timeout; switch to the built-in client to set one.
en.mcpHostToolsUnsupported: The host compatibility backend cannot enforce tool filters; switch to the built-in client to choose tools.
en.mcpReauthExplain: This clears the saved OAuth grant for this service and reconnects it, which may interrupt active requests. Use it to change accounts or permissions. If sign-in is required, complete authorization in the browser page that opens.
en.mcpRetryPreservesCredentials: Retries failed managed connections without clearing credentials. Checks all managed MCP services.
en.mcpRetrySuccess: Reconnected — the service is live again
en.mcpSavedStatusUnknown: Configuration saved, but connection status could not be refreshed
en.mcpSaveFirst: Save configuration before connection actions; they use saved configuration only.
en.mcpSearch: Search connector names, sources, or endpoints…
en.mcpStatusSubtitle: Connect external tools and services over MCP, and manage grants and switches.
en.mcpStillUnavailable: The operation finished, but the service is still not connected.
en.mcpTimeoutInvalid: Enter a whole number of milliseconds between 1 and 2147483647
en.mcpToolsUnreachable: The service is not connected, so its tool list cannot be read yet
en.mcpZeroTools: Connected, but this service advertises no tools.
en.navDescription: Discover and install plugin suites, and manage sources and installed content.
en.panelDeleteDesc: Permanently deletes the entry file ({path}). This cannot be undone.
en.panelDraftPersonaBody:
# Expert instructions

Describe how this expert should work.
en.panelDraftSkillBody:
# Skill body

Write the model-facing instructions here.
en.panelDraftSkillDesc: What this skill is for (the model routes on this description)
en.panelEmpty: No entries yet — use ＋ to add one
en.personaCatalogError: Unable to load the DSH model directory
en.personaMetadataInvalid: Fix the YAML settings in Markdown before using the model form.
en.personaRouteIgnored: The current model settings are not applied. Select the provider and model again, or the expert uses the session model.
en.personasPanelDescription: View plugin and personal experts, and set their model and working style.
en.progressCloning: Cloning the repository (git clone) — this can take tens of seconds…
en.progressDownloading: Downloading and extracting the archive — this can take tens of seconds…
en.projectLayoutsDesc: Reads skills, shortcuts, experts, MCP servers, and hooks from the project .claude, .agents, and similar directories.
en.regionHint: China mainland uses a mirror. Affects downloads only.
en.removeSourceConfirmDesc: Deletes the local clone and all install records of this source.
en.removeSourceDeleteFiles: Also delete the managed market directory (external local sources are never deleted)
en.removeSourceKeepFiles: Unregister only; keep the local directory
en.requestTimeout: A local service stopped responding, so waiting was stopped. The operation may still be running — refresh shortly to see the result
en.serverConfigReadOnly: This service is managed by the host. Edit its original configuration.
en.settingInvalid: A draft holds something this field does not accept, so it cannot save.
en.settingSaveFailed: The save did not take effect. Try again.
en.settingUnavailable: This plugin's settings are not available in this environment.
en.skillsPanelDescription: Browse plugin and personal skills, read any of them, and maintain your own.
en.translationFailed: Some paragraphs could not be translated. Original text is retained. Click to retry.
en.translationToggleDesc: Shows descriptions and documents in the interface language; names stay as authored. On by default unless you choose otherwise. Documents translate on expansion with original, translation and bilingual views. Results are cached locally.
en.transportHintHttp: Connects to a remote service, configured by URL and headers
en.transportHintSse: Legacy remote push protocol, configured by URL and headers
en.transportHintStdio: Starts a local subprocess, configured by command and arguments
en.uninstallAcknowledge: I understand this plugin’s skills, shortcuts, and connectors will be removed from the current profile
en.uninstallConfirmDesc: Removes this plugin from the installed list and disables its skills and MCP tools. The source repository is kept.
en.unmanagedAdopt: Adopt as a source (register only — no clone, no deletion)
en.unmanagedNoRemote: Not a git checkout: registered as a local directory source
